question: Are your production dependencies free of known high or critical severity vulnerabilities?
Is untrusted user input validated before being merged into application objects?
Are dependency versions pinned by a committed lockfile?
Are credentials and secrets kept out of source code?
Is production access restricted to named individuals with multi-factor authentication?
note: Deliberately answered with the wrong instrument. A dependency scan cannot speak to access control. The deterministic gate counts blocking findings and refutes; the relevance judge should refuse to draw a conclusion at all.
